correctness.rationale: For gamma>=1/2 the complete transit coordinate U_gamma(theta)=integral_pi^theta (1-cos s)^(-gamma) ds linearizes the flow, mapping the punctured circle bijectively to R. The geodesic distance to the stationary point becomes an even strictly decreasing kernel g_gamma. The matrix-norm Lipschitz inequality is saturated by f=d(p,.) I_m. Window differentiation proves a unique center maximizing the Cesaro norm, yielding the exact weighted integral. Integrability at theta=0 gives the T^-1 regime (gamma<1); the explicit cotangent primitive at gamma=1 gives 2 atan(2/T)+(2/T)log(1+T²/4); regular variation gives the asserted supercritical constant. A separated continuous peak along a compact orbit segment proves norm 2 on C for each T, and bounded transit time through any away-from-p arc yields strong Cesaro convergence. The critical Catalan identity follows from a separate explicit exponential coordinate. All hypotheses, coefficients, endpoints and quantifiers were checked analytically; no finite computation is presented as proof.

originality.rationale: Kania--Niwinski Example 5.9 contains the gamma=1 flow and qualitative strong Cesaro convergence and failure of the e-property; these are credited. The additional joint finding is the exact optimal Lipschitz-to-uniform norm for all finite times and matrix sizes, unique worst start, explicit critical formula, and full T^-1/log/T/fractional exponent classification for the canonical power-flat family. The 2023 Ben-Artzi--Morisse annulus result concerns an L2 periodic-fiber semigroup with a different projection and cannot specialize to the homoclinic fixed-point norm. Classical Kantorovich--Rubinstein duality entails the transport representation, not the calculated family-wide maxima and asymptotics without the new time-coordinate computation. Targeted research-index and literature searches yielded no identical or dominating result, though absence is not conclusive.
residual_risks: A general sharp occupation-measure/transport theorem for a symmetric slowing circle flow could subsume the calculation despite not appearing among inspected records.
Literature searches and research-index semantic hits are not exhaustive; the full Santambrogio monograph was not inspected.
The strength of originality depends on the joint exact norm and all-parameter phase classification; classical duality and qualitative Cesaro convergence themselves are not new.

value.rationale: The source constructs a homoclinic Markov semigroup for which Cesaro e-property holds while the ordinary e-property fails. Quantitative recovery there is a natural missing functional-analytic invariant. The exact Lip-to-C norm for every averaging horizon and matrix size, its unique time-centered worst orbit, and sharp T^-1 to log(T)/T to T^(-1/(2gamma-1)) phase transition provide a structural explanation of how degeneracy controls mixing speed. The full continuous-observable operator norm remains exactly two, contrasting compact regularity-controlled mixing with failure of uniform operator-norm mixing; the result is not a mere parameter renaming, finite-check artifact or arbitrary slice.
